Tardy/early-out note: Am breaker wasn’t here but we made it work!

XBro went okay today. I’ve mentioned before that I feel like I’m needed in a bunch of tasks at once and it’s hard helping everyone. I would communicate with staff when I was going to chef and couldn’t hand drinks out/be XBro. A few times I would just check around the corner and there were a bunch of drinks on the counter including the windows. Sarah is on drive bar and I just asked her kindly to be aware if a custie has been at the window for a while just check to see if their drinks are ready. I also yelled out to everyone to please pay attention when I say I’m on chef you need to hand out your own drinks! I did this multiple times today even though I already communicated that I’m making food. Just no awareness.

I moved the back fridge around for food to be more accessible and will make chef easier/faster! 
Just trying it out, I like it a lot better but let me know if you guys do/dont. 

This customer comes through very often orders the same cold brew. Every single time he comes back saying his drink is made wrong. I saw the order pop up today and watched ally make it completely right. He still came back and wanted it re made… I have before refused to give him the drink remade again when his drink is half empty. I just don’t know why he needs it remade every single time 😭

A few coaching moments for Sarah today
Not putting ice in cup before rebel, she knows better. 
And to have more awareness on shift. 

I feel like I’ve been noticing messy bars/lots of wasted extra product when making drinks. We should do a perfect pour competition or cleanliness competition!! Might be fun for newbies to get those mix lines down especially with steaming milk!
